items.title: Spain grows fruit and vegetables for Europe — but it's running out of water
items.description: Spain's southern coast produces up to 25% of Europe's fruit and vegetables. But amid intensive farming, climate change and illegal wells, the water it takes to grow them is drying up.

items.title: Fossil found on Welsh beach ends 'confusion' over 200-million-year-old fish teeth
items.description: Fossilised teeth across Europe had been wrongly identified until the latest find in south Wales.
